change.title: Add the Science Runtime Adoption Record
change.summary: Adds a private bounded source-only Science adoption ledger that compares validated executable predecessor/candidate observations, records deferred, rejected, and selected decisions, advances exact launch/finalize milestones, retains active compensation references, and binds new managed-launch receipt V2 provenance while retaining read-only V1 compatibility. Healthy Science is never restarted only to adopt a candidate, and no real Science user data or credentials are inspected.

basis: focused Rust tests cover all three decisions and milestones, receipt-only crash recovery without premature finalize, compensation-only retention, V2 exact cleanup, V1 compatibility, private bounded storage, and path/user-data exclusion
the production preflight records validated candidate observations while healthy Science remains running and only selects an adoption attempt on the normal stopped-to-started path

the one-click finalize intent persists the exact adoption attempt id; fresh replay advances only that attempt after binding CAS, while later preflight requires matching current receipt/runtime and committed binding before retrying finalize
canonical source-gate and clean-context independent review evidence are required before this change is accepted
no real Science account, organization, conversation, project, environment, credential, Keychain, SSH private key, installed App, provider, signing, or public-release validation is claimed
